exp.desc:
- Runs to Sweden, Norway and Denmark
- Load security and temperature records
- Accident-free

cl.enclosures:
CV
Licence and CPC card (copies)
ADR certificate
cl.p1: Eleven years of long-haul work, eight of them on refrigerated runs to Scandinavia, have given me a lot of experience and very few evenings at home. Your local delivery routes would change that.
cl.p2: I have driven accident-free throughout my career, secure loads properly even when the customer is in a hurry, and keep my hours legal. I hold an ADR certificate and a forklift licence, and my Driver CPC is current.
cl.p3: I live twenty minutes from your depot and can start after one month’s notice. I am happy to do an assessment drive.

letters.label: Long-haul driver moving to local work

cl.enclosures:
CV
Licence (copy)
CPC certificate
Forklift licence
cl.p1: I passed my category C test and initial CPC in September after twelve years in warehousing. I know what happens on the loading bay when a driver is late – I was the person waiting for him.
cl.p2: I am looking for an employer that supports new drivers, and your advert mentions a mentoring period with an experienced driver. In the warehouse I drove counterbalance and reach trucks and packed and secured outgoing loads.
cl.p3: Day shifts would be ideal, but I am flexible. I would welcome an assessment drive.
